chunks: 3164 - The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said to Ali, peace be upon him:

“O Ali, whoever visits me during my lifetime or after my death, or visits you during your lifetime or after your death, or visits your two sons during their lifetimes or after their deaths, I guarantee for him on the Day of Judgment that I will deliver him from its terrors and hardships until I bring him to be with me in my rank.”
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, Imam Ali عليه السلام, and al-Hasan and al-Husayn عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of the immense reward for visiting the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, Imam Ali عليه السلام, and his two sons. It promises deliverance from the terrors of the Day of Judgment and nearness to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in rank for those who perform such visitation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3164 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), peace be upon him:

"O Ali, whoever visits me during my lifetime or after my death, or visits you during your lifetime or after your death, or visits your two sons during their lifetimes or after their deaths, I guarantee for them on the Day of Judgment that I will deliver them from its terrors and hardships until I bring them to be with me in my rank."
